arcName: NDP 2026: The Show Must Go On

questions.title: The Debrief
questions.storyContext: 8:15pm. Last firework fades. Your team is in the ops room — dashboards green for the first time all day. You survived: the 3-week build, the rehearsal crash, the data wipe, the livestream meltdown. The NDP committee chair walks in, sits down: "I want to know what really happened."
questions.facilitatorPrompt: She's asking us directly. Do we tell her everything, or keep it clean? Think about what happens if she finds out from someone else later.

options.label: Tell her everything — the 2am call, the crashes, the data wipe, the stream nearly dying. She deserves the truth, and it's better coming from us.
Keep it professional. The app ran successfully with minor adjustments. She doesn't need to know how close we cut it. The show worked.
Walk her through the problems, but frame them as lessons learned. Not a damage report — a resilience report. She sees a team that got hit four times and kept standing.
Show her the numbers. 99.2% uptime, 40,000 served, positive social media after fireworks. Let the data speak for itself.

questions.title: One Shot
questions.storyContext: A week later, the Minister calls your team in. She's read the debrief — three crises in three weeks for a national event. "I can fund one investment over five years to make sure this never happens again. What do you want?"
questions.facilitatorPrompt: One shot. What was the real root cause across everything we faced? If we fix one thing, what prevents the most damage?

options.label: A permanent command centre for national events. Dedicated systems, dedicated team, year-round standby. We were scrambling because none of this existed.
An AI system that predicts failures, scales up automatically, and catches dangerous actions before they cause damage. That data wipe? The system stops it before it happens.
A system where no single failure brings everything down. Fifty smaller pieces instead of one big app. Problems stay contained instead of spreading.
Train 200 digital officers across government with step-by-step crisis guides. Technology breaks. People saved us every time. Scale that.
